about_the_game:
In this fun and thrilling casual game, we will take you back to the tense atmosphere of "Squid Adventure 3D" and launch you into a unique adventure!

You will play the role of a brave contestant who receives a mysterious invitation and joins this game of survival or death. The rules, derived from childhood games, conceal dangers. Each game appears simple but requires strategy and skill to succeed.

This is an adventure that will get your heart racing. Every victory will bring you rich rewards, and every failure is an opportunity to grow. Come and join the game, start your own adventure, and become the ultimate winner!

Unlimited Levels, Unique Experiences

Levels may end, but they will never stop!

Classic levels loop continuously, with difficulty levels constantly increasing. No need to worry about getting bored, as there will always be new content waiting for you.

Solo Play Without Team-Up

Squid Adventure Game 3D is a “multiplayer game” that can be enjoyed solo. No need to worry about the difficulty of finding a team. In single-player mode, you can play all levels by yourself.

Feel the Celebration at the End of Successful Level Completion

Each level is a combination of brainpower and manual dexterity. After overcoming numerous obstacles, you will be greeted with a victory celebration at the finish line!

Game Features:

  • Third-person perspective, providing a more immersive gaming experience.

  • 3D cartoon style, offering a more visually pleasing gaming experience.

  • Classic levels, rotating for continuous play. As long as you keep playing, the adventure never ends.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 760 / AMD Radeon R9 280X
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060
  • DirectX: Version 11

short_description: In Squid Adventure 3D, embark on a survival challenge that brings to life a variety of fun mini-games from the series, such as tug-of-war, Red Light Green Light, and honeycomb candy extraction. The outcome of these challenges will determine whether you win a huge cash prize or lose everything.
